# Git Manager Configuration

# Branch Naming Format
# Use {JIRA} as placeholder for Jira ticket ID (e.g., WC-12345)
FEATURE_BRANCH_FORMAT=feature/{JIRA}
BUGFIX_BRANCH_FORMAT=bugfix/{JIRA}

# Jira Ticket Pattern (regex)
# Pattern to extract Jira ID from branch names (e.g., WC-[0-9]+, PROJ-[0-9]+)
# Leave empty to be prompted on first use
JIRA_PATTERN=WC-[0-9]+
